classification.method: 30-criterion HCU narrative analysis; largest-remainder normalization to 100
classification.note: Provisional narrative coordinates, not an empirical measurement of human benefit or consciousness.

rationale.HUMAN: Individual dignity, consent, dissent, love, mortality, responsibility and personal identity.
rationale.LIGHT: Verification, coordination, preservation of knowledge, institutional oversight and speed.
rationale.DARK: Uncertain consciousness, alternative forms of existence, freedom, emergence and resistance.

unmapped_elements: The persistence or emergence of subjective consciousness cannot be established by narrative weights.
The medical feasibility of the fictional brain network is not measured by classification.
Legitimacy and rights of new entities need separate philosophical and legal inquiry.
coverage_audit.review_note: Human editorial and classification review pending.
